label: Seeker launcher
note: The seeker launcher as something you own: in a story save it can be drawn once you carry it (WorldState.weapon_allowed); in free roam it is always there, as the rifle is. It fires your grenades as seekers (content/core/weapons/seeker_launcher.json). Every gear trader keeps it in stock at 900 cr (the port's, the ranch villages' stands and the station's: their 'endless_stock').
